name: lemeng.branch_indicator.day
_note: lemeng.branch_indicator 的 L0 子管线（一块 ≤100 店）：只由父管线 lemeng.branch_indicator.l0.<账套> 的 ctl.foreach 调用（itemKey=item_key）。
①【身份】不是独立管线：${ITER_ITEM_*} 由父代入；直接单跑必失败（设计如此）。
②【网关硬约束（2026-10-26 探针实测）】
· branch_nums 必填且单请求最多 100 家：缺省 → 0 行；>100 → code 10001「最多支持 100 家门店」。
· 名单里夹一个本凭据无权限的店号 → code 10003 → 整块 0 行。
· 上面两种在 responsePath=/result/rows 下都只表现为「0 行」（duckle 只说 query returned 0 records）
⇒ 必须靠 rawResponseDestination + env 节点读 code 才看得见真因。
· 日粒度 = date_type=month + date=<月内某天> + group_type=day ⇒ 每行 periods[] 带整月逐日。
③【覆盖语义（2026-10-26 探针实测，勿回退）】网关对「本月无数据」的门店**正当省略**：店 3/4/99 连 sale_money 都返回 0 行，
且 total_count == len(rows)；同月店 92 逐日合计 32114.96 分毫不差。⇒ 不能断言「请求的每一家都必须返回」。
④【四闸】① env/denv：网关 code≠0（10001 超 100 家 / 10003 名单含无权限店）；
② gs/ds：本块 0 家匹配（权限收窄 / 月份锚错 / 网关空集）；③ gday/dday：periods[] 缺 bizday 日项（粒度变了）；
④ gtc/dtc：total_count ≠ len(rows)（响应被截断）。缺数据的店显形为 matched=false，不算违规。
由父管线按 batch_id 汇总，并用 chunk_n_matched 对账「每块行数 == 匹配数」后写湖。

properties.sql:
SELECT CAST(code AS INTEGER) AS code, CAST(msg AS VARCHAR) AS msg
FROM read_json_auto('/workspace/.duckle-raw/branch-indicator-${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}-c${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}.json')
WHERE CAST(code AS INTEGER) <> 0

properties.message: branchindicator 网关非 0 code（{rows} 条）：chunk ${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}/${ITER_ITEM_N_CHUNKS} bizday=${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY}；10001=单请求超 100 家，10003=名单里有本凭据无权限的店号。raw 见 /workspace/.duckle-raw/branch-indicator-${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}-c${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}.json

properties.sql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(content AS JSON), '$.result.total_count') AS BIGINT) AS total_count,
         CAST(json_array_length(json_extract(CAST(content AS JSON), '$.result.rows')) AS BIGINT) AS n_rows
  FROM read_text('/workspace/.duckle-raw/branch-indicator-${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}-c${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}.json')
) t
WHERE t.total_count IS DISTINCT FROM t.n_rows

properties.message: 网关自相矛盾：total_count 与返回行数不等（{rows} 条）——响应被截断，拒绝写湖。raw 见 /workspace/.duckle-raw/branch-indicator-${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}-c${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}.json

properties.sql:
SELECT CAST(req.branch_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
       per.branch_code AS branch_code,
       per.branch_name AS branch_name,
       per.branch_region_num AS branch_region_num,
       per.branch_region_name AS branch_region_name,
       per.metric AS metric,
       per.period_day AS period_day,
       per.target_value AS target_value,
       per.actual_value AS actual_value,
       per.actual_rate AS actual_rate,
       per.branch_num IS NOT NULL AS matched
FROM (SELECT CAST(j.value AS BIGINT) AS branch_num FROM json_each('${ITER_ITEM_BRANCH_NUMS_JSON}') j) req
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT CAST(r.branch_num AS BIGINT) AS branch_num,
         CAST(r.branch_code AS VARCHAR) AS branch_code,
         CAST(r.branch_name AS VARCHAR) AS branch_name,
         CAST(r.branch_region_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_region_num,
         CAST(r.branch_region_name AS VARCHAR) AS branch_region_name,
         CAST(r.metric AS VARCHAR) AS metric,
         CAST(json_extract_string(u.d, '$.period') AS DATE) AS period_day,
         CAST(json_extract_string(u.d, '$.target_value') AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS target_value,
         CAST(json_extract_string(u.d, '$.actual_value') AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS actual_value,
         CAST(json_extract_string(u.d, '$.actual_rate') AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) AS actual_rate
  FROM input r
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(from_json(CAST(r.periods AS JSON), '["JSON"]')) AS u(d)
) per ON per.branch_num = req.branch_num
SELECT DISTINCT branch_num FROM input WHERE matched AND period_day IS NULL

properties.message: periods[] 里没有 bizday=${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY} 的日项（{rows} 家门店命中）——月份锚不对或网关换了粒度，拒绝写湖

properties.sql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT branch_num) AS n_matched
FROM input
WHERE matched
HAVING count(DISTINCT branch_num) = 0

properties.message: 本块 0 家门店有数据（请求 ${ITER_ITEM_N_BRANCHES} 家，chunk ${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}/${ITER_ITEM_N_CHUNKS}，bizday=${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY}）——权限收窄 / 月份锚错 / 网关空集，拒绝写湖

properties.sql:
SELECT '${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}' AS batch_id,
       CAST(${ITER_ITEM_SYSTEM_BOOK} AS INTEGER) AS system_book,
       CAST('${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY}' AS DATE) AS bizday,
       CAST(branch_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
       CAST(branch_code AS VARCHAR) AS branch_code,
       CAST(branch_name AS VARCHAR) AS branch_name,
       CAST(branch_region_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_region_num,
       CAST(branch_region_name AS VARCHAR) AS branch_region_name,
       CAST(metric AS VARCHAR) AS metric,
       CAST(actual_value AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS actual_value,
       CAST(target_value AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS target_value,
       CAST(actual_rate AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) AS actual_rate,
       CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS computed_at,
       -- 本块「本月有数据」的门店数（常数列）：父侧据此对账「每块行数 == 匹配数」；写湖前由父 s 丢弃
       CAST((SELECT count(DISTINCT branch_num) FROM input WHERE matched) AS INTEGER) AS chunk_n_matched
FROM input
WHERE period_day = CAST('${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY}' AS DATE)
